# =============================================================================
# CI 配置说明
#
# 本文件是 GitHub Actions 工作流（后端测试 / 真实 OpenLDAP 集成 / 前端构建 / 镜像构建）。
# 因发布凭据无 workflow 权限，未能直接写入 .github/workflows/ 目录。
#
# 启用方法：把本文件重命名为 .github/workflows/ci.yml 提交即可
# （在 GitHub 网页上传，或用具备 workflow 权限的账号推送）。
# =============================================================================

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

jobs:
  backend:
    name: 后端（vet + 单元/替身/e2e 测试）
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: "1.23"
      - name: 下载依赖
        run: go mod download
      - name: go vet
        run: go vet ./...
      - name: 单元 / 线协议 / e2e 测试
        run: go test ./... -count=1 -v 2>&1 | tee test.log
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: backend-test-log
          path: test.log

  integration:
    name: 集成（真实 OpenLDAP）
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    services:
      openldap:
        image: osixia/openldap:1.5.0
        env:
          LDAP_DOMAIN: example.cn
          LDAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD: adminpass
        ports:
          - 1389:389   # osixia/openldap 容器内固定监听 389（不是 1389）
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "ldapsearch -x -H ldap://localhost:389 -b dc=example,dc=cn (objectClass=*)"
          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 12
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: "1.23"
      - name: 真实 OpenLDAP 集成测试
        env:
          LDAP_IT_URL: ldap://localhost:1389
          LDAP_IT_BIND_DN: cn=admin,dc=example,dc=cn
          LDAP_IT_PASSWORD: adminpass
          LDAP_IT_BASE_DN: dc=example,dc=cn
        run: go test ./internal/ldapclient/ -run Integration -v -count=1

  frontend:
    name: 前端（构建）
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
      - name: 安装依赖
        working-directory: web
        run: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
      - name: 类型检查
        working-directory: web
        run: npm run typecheck
      - name: 构建
        working-directory: web
        run: npm run build

  docker:
    name: Docker 镜像
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [backend, frontend]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3
      - name: 构建镜像（不推送）
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          push: false
          tags: newldap:ci
